Title: Establishes September twenty-fifth of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "9 to 5 Day"
Summary: Establishes September twenty-fifth of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "9 to 5 Day" in honor of Dolly Parton.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to establishing September twenty-fifth of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "9 to 5 Day"
